text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about
with Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Whoa, look, look at this! It's super cute!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Vivlos was pointing,
there was a claw machine filled with
plushies modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainy~!
Get it for me, get it for me~♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it great? Right?
It makes me way happier when you win it for me, Trainy, than if I got it myself♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Pleaaase♡
I'll cheer for you a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Do your best...♡ Just for me♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
